title: Protein Extraction from Dental Enamel
author: simon.daled
materials: Demineralisation Add 200µL of 1.2M HCl to each sample tube. Vortex the tubes briefly to mix. Incubate for two hours in a thermo-mixer, using moderate agitation at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect Enamel Powder
steps.instruction: Collect powdered enamel from the tooth crown using a drill.

substeps.instruction: Label and weigh an Eppendorf tube for each sample.
Place the tooth on a fresh piece of weighing paper on a clean worktop.
Gently abrade the surface of the tooth crown with a small drill bit to remove powdered enamel onto the weighing paper.
Use a fresh drill bit for each tooth and clean between uses.
Optional: Process additional empty Eppendorfs alongside samples as controls (suggested 1:9).

steps.title: Sample Weighing
steps.instruction: Transfer and weigh the collected enamel powder.

substeps.instruction: Carefully tip the powdered enamel into a protein lo-bind Eppendorf tube.
Weigh the tube and record the weight of the powdered enamel.

steps.title: Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate proteins using TCA (based on ~5mg enamel quantities).

substeps.instruction: Add 100% TCA (in water) to a final concentration of 33% (V/V) (e.g., 100µL).
Incubate on ice for one hour.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 15,000G at 0°C.
Pipette off and discard the supernatants (or retain and freeze).

steps.title: Pellet Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the protein pellet with acetone.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 500µL of ice-cold acetone into each sample tube.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 15,000G.
Pipette off and discard the supernatants (or retain).

steps.title: Buffer Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in urea buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 200µL of 8M urea in 1M ABC buffer (pH 8).
Vortex and sonicate until all pellets are fully resuspended.
Add DTT to a final concentration of 5mM.
Incubate for 30 minutes at 37°C.

steps.title: Protein Alkylation
steps.instruction: Alkylate proteins using MMTS in the dark.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a fresh stock solution of MMTS in 2-propanol (200mM) immediately prior to use.
Add MMTS to a final concentration of 10mM in each sample.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 15 minutes, minimizing light exposure.

steps.title: Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest proteins using trypsin or trypsin/lysine-C.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a solution of trypsin, or trypsin and lysine-C, in 1M ammonium bicarbonate.
Add enzyme at a 1:25 (w/w) enzyme/protein ratio (approximately 1-2µg per sample).
Incubate overnight at 37°C.
If visible debris remains after digestion, sonicate until broken up.

steps.title: Sample Drying
steps.instruction: Vacuum-dry the samples for storage or transport.

substeps.instruction: Vacuum-dry the samples (drying at up to 40°C can be used to accelerate the process).
Store refrigerated in a dry state, or freeze if storing for more than 2 days.

steps.title: Optional Peptide Standardization
steps.instruction: Add heavy labelled amelogenin peptide standards and resuspend.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a solution of amelogenin heavy labelled peptide standards in 0.1% formic acid.
Add heavy peptides to a concentration of around 5fmol/µL (depending on LC-MS/MS sensitivity).
Add 10-30µL of 0.1% formic acid (containing heavy standards) to each sample tube, adjusting volume based on desired injection volume and instrument sensitivity.
Sonicate and vortex to ensure thorough solubilization.
Centrifuge at 16,000G for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer to MS Vials
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to MS sampling vials.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sample to MS sampling vials, ensuring no visible pellets from the bottom or walls of the Eppendorf tubes are transferred.
Re-centrifuge if pellets detach or disintegrate into the supernatant.

steps.title: Optional Solid-Phase Extraction Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean up samples using Strata tubes.

substeps.instruction: Condition one Strata tube per sample with 1mL MeOH.
Equilibrate tubes twice with 1mL ultrapure water (do not let filters dry out; stop draining ~1mm above the filter).
Replace waste collection tubes with fresh Eppendorf lo-bind tubes.
Slowly load 1mL of sample per tube.
Wash twice with 1 mL of 5% MeOH in ultrapure water (cartridge may run dry here).
Elute with 1 mL of 1% FA in MeOH: let a small amount soak the cartridge for 2 minutes, then slowly elute with the remainder.
Dilute the samples to a final concentration of 2M urea with 1M ABC buffer.
